checkoutViewerBundle.note: differs from the packaged one; the preview is not a measured surface here

build.whyPackagedStandsForHead: git diff v0.2.4..HEAD (44 commits) touches 0 files under noodl-core-ui/src/components, noodl-core-ui/src/styles, views/panels/propertyeditor, noodl-editor/src/assets/css or editor/index.html, and 1 file under preview/launcher (Launcher/components/ProjectCreationWizard/steps/templateFilter.ts, the new-project wizard, which is not photographed). The other src changes are validation/, AI prompts and landing-pages.content.json.

viewport.why: the display is 1440x900 with availHeight 781; Electron clamps the 1368x900 default window to it. The audit's own shots were 1368x900. Both themes were taken at 781, so the pair is comparable; CHR-011 must use the same box.

method.eval: measure.js in this directory, run by capture.js over one CDP connection
method.auditMethod: every element under the root, no visibility filter. Reproduces the audit exactly on the Templates tab over body: 146-147 elements, 10 font sizes, radii 2px 3px 4px 7px 8px 50% 100%
method.visible: elements with a non-empty client rect and visibility != hidden
method.textBearing: visible elements with a direct non-whitespace text node - what a person reads
method.ratchetNote: the audit's 10 on Templates includes elements that are not on screen (10px, 15px, 20px). A ratchet that counts them can be moved by deleting hidden markup; CHR-002 should ratchet the visible or text-bearing count and say which.

shadowGateHints.note: Offset X, Offset Y, Blur Radius, Spread Radius, Inset, Shadow Color - 6 text matches and 6 'Go to Shadow Enabled' buttons, both themes

surfaces.note: identical in dark and light except where shown; full per-surface tallies are in raw/measured-<theme>.json

editor-nodepicker.note: whole window, so it includes the panel and chrome behind the modal; not a picker-only number

static.method: find <dir> -type f (.scss .css .ts .tsx .js .jsx, excluding *.test.* *.spec.* *.stories.*) | xargs -0 grep -aoE <pattern> | wc -l - occurrences, not lines
